value.heading: Initial Application Inquiry
value.notice: Please understand, this is not the application to apply but an opportunity to “see who you are”. After HK9 receives this inquiry, an HK9 representative will reach out for a phone conversation and baseline assessment, and the full application will be emailed to the Veteran. This inquiry form was rebuilt for the new site; the original online form could not be recovered from the live site.
